evidence: empty_void: seg2:mid and seg2:end waste roughly half the frame — nothing at all between the gauge bottom (~y420) and the caption (~y660), and the top band above the cut-off title is bare; seg3:end likewise has a dead ~250px gap between the '2024 35M' title and the first block.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:mid (t=20.72) and seg2:end (t=23.70): the scene title is scaled far past the frame width and bleeds off both left and right edges, reading 'AL NOMAD VISA COUNTRIES ARE CO'; the mascot sits on top of the leading digit of '12.2%'; the bottom ~40% of the frame is empty gradient; and the gauge settles on '39.0% Europe' after seg2:start already stated 'Europe 40%'.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The gauge composer draws the kicker headline at an unmeasured type size (no fit-to-frame measurement, unlike the seg2:start stacked-share card which wraps correctly), and places the mascot by a fixed anchor that is not tested against the number's bounding box; the value also animates to a rounded-differently figure than the share card that precedes it.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Re-lay out seg2's gauge beat so the headline is MEASURED to fit inside the safe area and wraps like seg2:start's title, move Data clear of the '39.0%' glyph box, fill or crop the dead lower half so the gauge uses the frame, and make the gauge terminate on the same 40% figure the preceding share beat states.
